name: Cast Shadow
designNote: Aha: Sol's light is Lune's shadow. Lune can't make her own bridge; Sol pushes the lantern under the gap's column, and the light on his side throws a shadow bridge across hers.
hints: Lune's bridge is made of shadow. What casts a shadow on her side?
Light on Sol's side is shadow on Lune's. Push the lantern into the gap's column.
